name: Lum Final APK Install Route
goal: Turn one exact proposed source head into a verified installable APK, route its evidence bundle into the private LuHm OS Drive build directory, and stop before physical installation unless the Professor installs it.

flow.action: bind exact GitHub branch and head SHA
execute the deterministic GitHub Actions build only after the requested build mutation exists
verify APK package, version, signature, 16K zipalign, payload and SHA-256
resolve exact GitHub artifact and private Drive destination
download exact GitHub artifact through authorized connector
upload APK and evidence bundle to the private LuHm OS Drive build directory
reject GREEN if source SHA, artifact digest, APK hash or Drive file receipt disagree
report source/build/delivery status and hand physical install control to Professor

terminal_states.GREEN_SOURCE_BUILD_DELIVERY: CI and Drive delivery receipts agree; device install may still be pending
terminal_states.AMBER_DEVICE: physical install or runtime smoke is missing
terminal_states.RED: one or more deterministic gates failed
